claims.claim: The fixture matches the requested identity, dimensions and five-part enclosure.
claims.evidence: asset/asset.json identifies cage_01 as kind fixture; asset/model.urdf has one base link and four side walls plus roof. readings.json and probes/02_geometry.out give outer bounds x,y = [-0.06,0.06] m and z = [0,0.12] m, 0.01 m wall/roof thickness, and interior 0.10 x 0.10 x 0.11 m.

claims.claim: Collision geometry matches the visual enclosure and preserves the empty interior and open bottom.
claims.evidence: probes/02_geometry.out verifies exact equality of all five visual/collision box origins, rotations and sizes and agreement with readings.json. renders/front.png, side.png, top.png and iso.png show the expected plain closed exterior. The URDF contains no bottom or interior collision geometry.

claims.claim: The cage has no gap through which a finger can reach the enclosed cube when fixed on the supporting surface.
claims.evidence: readings.json collision_boxes and probes/01_cube.out bounds: all four walls extend continuously from z=0 to 0.12 m; adjacent wall faces meet at x or y = +/-0.05 m. The roof spans the entire inner square at z=0.11 to 0.12 m and meets every wall. The support plane closes the sole opening at z=0.

claims.claim: Joint travel, attachment and inter-link interference checks are not applicable.
claims.evidence: readings.json joints is empty; probes/02_geometry.out joint_count is 0; asset/model.urdf contains only the base link.

claims.claim: Handle grasp and pull checks are not applicable.
claims.evidence: request.md requires no handles; readings.json handles is empty.

claims.claim: Place-target checks are not applicable, and the specifically requested cube settles inside without touching the cage.
claims.evidence: readings.json place_targets is empty. probes/01_cube.py tests a 0.05 m cube of 0.1 kg inside the fixed cage on a support plane. probes/01_cube.out shows its centre unchanged at approximately (0,0,0.02497) m after 30, 150 and 300 cumulative frames (1, 5 and 10 seconds), with no asset contacts at each sample. Side clearance is 0.025 m and roof clearance approximately 0.06003 m.

claims.claim: Free rigid-object upright settling is not applicable to this fixed fixture.
claims.evidence: request.md and asset/asset.json specify kind fixture loaded fixed. probes/01_cube.out confirms the fixed base remains at (0,0,0) with identity rotation throughout the 300-frame test.
